name: Phenicia
overview: Phenicia, also known as Phoenicia or Phenice, was a region inhabited by descendants of Canaan, specifically called Zidonians or Sidonians, as noted in Genesis 10:15 and Judges 18:7. The borders of the Canaanites extended from Sidon to Gaza, encompassing the area known as Phenicia (Genesis 10:19). The Zidonians are mentioned as a distinct people in both historical and prophetic contexts (Ezekiel 32:30). In the New Testament, Jews from this region heard Jesus’ teachings, and Paul later visited the congregations established there, highlighting the area's continued spiritual significance (Mark 3:8).
